claims.text: Pentex began as Premium Oil, built up by the oil tycoon Jeremiah Lassater; after both Lassater and the heir died early in the twentieth century, Colin Jenner took control, set up a five-member Board of Directors and renamed the firm Pentex.

Its later directors include Harold Zettler and Executive Vice President Peter Culliford, whose combined experience is said to span more than a thousand years; Culliford reorganised the Board into its present subdivisions in 1994.

title: Project Lycaon’s soldiers
summary: Pentex’s home-grown shapeshifters in the field.

claims.text: Thanks to Project Lycaon, Pentex now fields a crack unit (War Wolves, Anurana and Samsa) that fights beside the First Teams, turning the shapeshifters’ own weapons against them; now and then a Black Spiral Dancer serves as officer or tactician.

title: Easton
summary: An energy firm quietly inside Pentex.

claims.text: Pentex absorbed Easton more than a decade ago without announcing it; Easton works as a sister company to Endron in experimental energy, and the two share resources freely.
